title: Jayco, Picnic Confirm WorldTour Plans for 2027 Despite Registration Hiccups
content:
Jayco-AlUla and Picnic-PostNL explain their UCI registration delays and confirm both plan to race in the 2027 WorldTour.

Read the full article at Jayco, Picnic Confirm WorldTour Plans for 2027 Despite Registration Hiccups on Velo.
